name: Temple Chapel
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: The floor is covered in a wine-red velvet carpet, and the walls with
desc4: gleaming golden candelabras. There is an ornate altar on the west
desc5: wall, and a large engraved bowl full of coins of all sorts stands
desc6: nearby. A small shelf with holy items for sale stands off to the side
